forward_compatibility: New SDKs must requalify the excluded capabilities before enabling them; this change does not promise behavior on untested SDKs.
inventory_text_only_changes: UdpSocket.close retains the same parameter and return types; only whitespace around its parameter list differs.
meaning: Classification completed; PASS is not an ABI-compatibility claim.
release_policy: Intentional pre-1.0 M8 inventory change; no stable binary compatibility guarantee.
rule: PDF-rule-derived: Cangjie API declaration compatibility specification 5.1.3.3.3.10.1 classifies adding a struct instance field as ABI-incompatible.
scenario_evidence: compat-agent is not installed on PATH. No old/new binary compatibility scenario was run.
semantic_changes: Internet UDP retains native connected send and reports connectedDatagramSend=true.
Unix streams and listeners preserve shared contexts, terminal ownership and lossless endpoint diagnostics.
Outgoing Unix abstract names are restricted to exactly107 valid UTF-8 bytes by the qualified SDK; the shared arbitrary-byte endpoint model is unchanged.
Unix connected send is Unsupported with connectedDatagramSend=false because even SDK send re-resolves the selected name. Native receive filtering and explicit sendTo remain available.
Empty Unix datagram receive remains supported; empty send and unnamed sender conversion are SDK limitations.
source_compatibility: Existing constructor call forms retain the added named parameter default; 48 existing network cases and a clean external consumer compile and run. No universal downstream source-compatibility claim.
